cues: Gases move only by diffusion, down partial pressure gradients.
Ninety seven percent of oxygen rides on haemoglobin, each molecule carrying four oxygens.
The curve of saturation against oxygen pressure is S shaped: nearly full in the lungs, and giving oxygen up steeply around the tissues.
